newsitem.title: USA: Cigna says HMO membership up 10 pct in Q3.
newsitem.headline: Cigna says HMO membership up 10 pct in Q3.

text.p: Cigna Corp said HMO medical membership grew by about 400,000 covered lives, or 10 percent, since September 30, 1995.
Cigna said its employee life and health benefits segment, which which includes Cigna's HMO and indemnity operations, had operating income of $127 million in the third quarter of 1996.
This compares with operating income of $136 million in the third quarter of 1995.
The employee retirement and savings benefits segment, which operates in the defined contribution and defined benefit markets, had operating income of $52 million in the third quarter of 1996.
This compares with operating income of $48 million in the third quarter of 1995.
Assets under management at September 30, 1996, were $39.0 billion, an increase of five percent from $37.2 billion as of September 30, 1995.

The individual financial services segment, which includes individual and corporate-owned life insurance, life, accident and health reinsurance, and annuity businesses, had operating income of $47 million in the third quarter of 1996.
This compares with operating income of $36 million in the third quarter of 1995.
